# Official eSocial communication schemas

Source: https://www.gov.br/esocial/pt-br/documentacao-tecnica/manuais/pacote-de-comunicacao-esocial-v1-6-alfa.zip

ZIP SHA-256: `09b864ce66f9a9b9afb675280ec9c01c0201dcd861490a20ea7945948b5a7ae7`

Retrieved 2026-11-01. Files are unmodified copies of the official communication package; no real worker or certificate data is included. Generated test SOAP responses are synthetic instances of these schemas, not responses obtained from a real transmission. The 1.6-Alfa package preserves the WSDL and namespace versions and changes registration patterns to support alphanumeric CNPJ.
